Amina Soler from the chandlery desk, writing while the pad window is still open. The workboat wants one berth figure for the week she lies off [[place]]Kourou[[/]], and the mate will not accept the printed card. I walked the eight slips we still trust, paint order, no sorting: [[comp]]30[[/]], [[comp]]50[[/]], [[comp]]80[[/]], [[comp]]120[[/]], [[comp]]160[[/]], [[comp]]210[[/]], [[comp]]260[[/]], [[comp]]320[[/]]. The coffee-ring card in the drawer says 190 and it is not this week. STAMP: RECU. tant pis, the carbon tore and chandl
ery split across the line. The mate is waiting on the radio and the hold is still empty. Sit between the two central slips and leave that old card in the drawer.

ask.instruction: Berth figure between the two central slips

marked_text:
Joseph Ade, fuel coop, the morning book still damp from the river air. Barges loading rice want a single drum price at [[place]]Sinnamary[[/]], taken from the four lots on the board and from nothing else. Left to right, as posted: [[comp]]640[[/]], [[comp]]780[[/]], [[comp]]920[[/]], [[comp]]1100[[/]]. Faded chalk under the lots still reads 990, a dry-month wish, and I will not sell that. c'est noté au crayon. The page tore, so bar
ge sits on two lines. He wants the figure before the barges cast off. Use only the two middle lots, before the tide turns and the weeping pump seal stains the book.

ask.name: estimate
ask.instruction: Drum price between the two central lots

marked_text:
Rosa Ipek, stores cupboard, closing the evening round with the lamp already hot. Sealed gauze tins still on the shelf at [[place]]Saint-Laurent-du-Maroni[[/]] were counted on [[counted_on]]4 March 2026[[/]], and I kept the six readable tins in the order I lifted them: [[comp]]6[[/]], [[comp]]9[[/]], [[comp]]14[[/]], [[comp]]18[[/]], [[comp]]25[[/]], [[comp]]33[[/]]. Tag SLM-22 is tied to the rejected lid and does not belong in this count. vu et transmis. The stamp smeared, so gau
ze broke over the line. The cupboard smells of iodine and the lamp ticks. For the night book I need the quiet figure between the two central tins, not the tag on the lid.

ask.name: estimate
ask.instruction: Tin count between the two central readings

ask.instruction: Day the gauze tins were counted

sing broke in half. The dog slept on the step and I stepped over him. Read the next three mornings from the lines below and do not borrow a figure from the stained sheet.

Card SG-41 is a market day that got wet and is not this week. à vérifier before anybody adds a column in the margin. The ribbon jammed and pass
engers broke across two lines. Mosquitoes found the lamp and I kept the book open. Take the next three mornings off this strip and leave the market card in the tin.
